extracted.intended_audience: agency legislative liaisons and OMB clearance contacts (staff responsible for transmitting cleared legislation, reports, testimony to Congress)
extracted.subtask_short: submitting final copies under OMB A-19
extracted.subtask_description: Procedural requirement for federal agencies to provide OMB/LRD with final copies of items cleared under OMB Circular No. A-19 and to notify OMB of changes in transmission or testimony scheduling. Focuses on post-clearance handling and recordkeeping to preserve the Administration's public position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Provide two copies of final cleared items to OMB/LRD
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide OMB/LRD two copies of all proposed legislation, transmittal letters and accompanying materials, and reports (including testimony) in the form actually transmitted to Congress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The memorandum requests agencies ensure OMB receives two copies of the exact materials as transmitted; this supports accurate legislative files reflecting the Administration's public position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate notification if cleared items will not be transmitted promptly
rubrics_metrics.description: Notify OMB immediately if reports or proposed legislation that have received OMB clearance will not be transmitted promptly to Congress.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Timely notice to OMB is required when transmission is delayed so OMB's legislative files remain accurate and up-to-date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Immediate notification if cleared testimony is cancelled or rescheduled
rubrics_metrics.description: Notify OMB immediately if cleared testimony has been cancelled or rescheduled.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Agencies must inform OMB of changes to testimony scheduling to maintain correct records and the Administration's public position.

rubrics_metrics.name: Compliance with OMB Circular No. A-19 (sections 8c.(4) and 8c.(6))
rubrics_metrics.description: This request is made pursuant to OMB Circular No. A-19 (sections 8c.(4) and 8c.(6)).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the cited sections of OMB Circular A-19 governing clearance and post-clearance procedures; providing copies and notifications implements those procedural requirements and helps ensure legislative files accurately reflect Administration positions.
